objective: Complete the bounded end-to-end simulator gate: collector motion, reset, causal local observations, step ordering, smoke policies, trajectory schemas, and limiting-case tests.

frozen_contract.collector_motion: q_next=reflect(q+dt*v_max*clip_l2(action,1)); holonomic; no action noise or collision force
frozen_contract.reset_particle_rule: IID uniform from initialization stream with distance strictly greater than capture_radius+1e-12 from every collector
frozen_contract.observation: self position; teammate relative positions; K=32 nearest free in-radius particles with relative position, causal apparent velocity, radial distance, particle mask, and velocity-valid mask
step_order: move free particles using pre-generated noise
resolve post-motion captures from pre-step aggregate geometry
frozen_contract.primary_prohibition: No smoke output may be interpreted as evidence for a detectability, coordination, aggregation, or MARL claim.

fallback_task: Reduce to deterministic microcases and repair the first violated invariant; do not run performance experiments.
